content:
noah: Small doc bug: dedicated provisioning page maps tenant label -> isolation level incorrectly. It says label 'critical' maps to "low_preempt", which is opposite.
emma: Good catch. That would be bad if someone copies it. Can you point to the exact line?
noah: File: docs/dedicated/provisioning.md, under 'isolation decorators' block, paragraph 3.
rachel: Also saw a Go SDK snippet that imports github.com/redwood/sdk v0.3 — we bumped to v0.8. The example panics on nil context.
yusuf: Let's fix both in one PR: 1) correct the isolation mapping text, 2) replace Go example with safe context usage and updated import, 3) add a small note about eviction priority semantics.
noah: Proposed isolation sentence: "Labels map to isolation tiers; e.g., 'critical' -> reserved (highest eviction priority: lowest chance of preemption)."
emma: I'd phrase "eviction priority" as "preemption risk" to be clearer for non-infra readers.
rachel: For the Go snippet, suggest:
```go
ctx := context.Background()
client := sdk.NewClient("$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp, err := client.Dedicated.ProvisionTenant(ctx, "team-z", sdk.ProvisionOptions{Labels: []string{"team-z"}})
if err != nil { log.Fatalf("provision failed: %v", err) }
fmt.Println(resp.ID)
```
yusuf: Also add a one-line table (bullet list) mapping label -> behavior: 'critical' -> reserved, 'standard' -> burstable, 'guest' -> best-effort. Keep a link to SLA, don't change SLA numbers.
docs-bot: PR draft opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5102 by noah — 1 file changed (provisioning.md)
emma: Quick review left: change "highest eviction priority" -> "lowest preemption risk" and add inline code markers for labels.
noah: Updated wording and pushed.
rachel: LGTM on Go example and import bumped to v0.8. I ran it against local mock.
yusuf: Can we add a note: "If you rely on strict anti-preemption guarantees, use Dedicated + Reserved pools and discuss with your account team" so customers know to engage sales for SLAs.
noah: I'll add that as a parenthetical with a link to the enterprise contact page.
docs-bot: PR 5102 opened for review.
infra-bot: docs staging deploy queued for PR 5102 -> build 1100
emma: Checked staging once the deploy finished. Mapping and snippet render nicely. One tiny nit: change code fence language to go instead of golang.
noah: Fixed and merged. Closing thread.
